content.value_statement: Referral and affiliate programs can waste budget when incentives, attribution, and customer outreach lack clear rules. This skill helps plan measurable programs and responsible customer review workflows.
actual_capabilities: Compare customer referral programs, affiliate partnerships, and product-embedded viral mechanisms.
Design referral triggers, sharing methods, conversion flows, and single-sided or double-sided rewards.
Calculate reward budgets, cohort contribution, referral acquisition costs, and return metrics from supplied figures.
Draft affiliate activation plans, attribution decisions, payout reconciliation checks, and outreach copy.
Prepare neutral review invitations, evidence-based response drafts, reputation queues, and testimonial permission ledgers.
Suggest referral experiments and measurement plans that distinguish attributed revenue from incremental growth.
limitations: Does not include executable integrations or a standalone referral tracking system.
Sending invitations, publishing replies, changing settings, and paying commissions require suitable tools and user authorization.
Economics and growth estimates depend on supplied data; illustrative benchmarks do not guarantee results.
Platform policies and legal requirements need current verification; generated terms are not legal advice.

use_cases.title: Launch a customer referral pilot
use_cases.description: Create a referral loop, combined reward budget, launch checklist, and participation experiments for an existing customer base.

use_cases.title: Operate an affiliate partner program
use_cases.description: Define partner activation, eligible revenue, attribution priority, payout holds, and cohort contribution reporting.

use_cases.title: Build a responsible review workflow
use_cases.description: Prepare neutral invitations, response drafts, bounded reminders, and evidence records without excluding dissatisfied customers.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a program type
prompt_templates.prompt: Our [product] serves [audience] at [price]. Compare customer referrals, affiliates, and product-embedded sharing, then recommend a small first pilot.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: selecting a customer advocacy approach.

prompt_templates.title: Design a referral pilot
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a two-sided referral pilot with target CAC [amount] and other acquisition costs [amount]. Include triggers, combined reward limits, invitation copy, and metrics.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: turning a referral idea into a budgeted launch plan.

prompt_templates.title: Plan neutral review requests
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan review requests for [platform] after [experience milestone]. Include current policy checks, neutral eligibility, deduplication, opt-outs, a reminder limit, and authorization before sending.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: establishing a compliant customer review workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Audit affiliate economics and attribution
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this affiliate cohort: [revenue, refunds, costs, commissions, attribution records]. Reconcile payout states, calculate contribution, identify attribution limits, and propose an incrementality test.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: evaluating partner profitability and evidence of incremental growth.

output_examples.input: Target referral CAC is $200. Other acquisition costs are $40. What can we spend on a two-sided cash reward?
output: Maximum combined reward budget: $160 per new paying customer.
Example split: $80 to the referrer and $80 to the referred customer.
Total referral CAC: $200, including the $40 in other acquisition costs.
Check refunds, retention, and cash payback before committing the offer.

output_examples.input: Partner customers paid $12,000, with $2,000 refunds and a 20% commission. Costs include $3,000 variable, $800 support, $1,200 operations, and $100 payout fees.
output: Cohort contribution after the listed costs: $2,900.
Attributed revenue alone does not prove incremental growth. Compare an appropriate holdout or label the measurement as observational.

output_examples.input: Plan a no-incentive review request after customers complete their first project.
output: Use the same experience milestone for satisfied and dissatisfied customers.
Exclude prior invitations and opt-outs, then verify the authorized contact channel.
Draft: You completed your first project with [Product]. Please share an honest review at [verified review link]. All feedback is welcome.
Assign an owner and agree on a reminder limit before authorizing sends.

best_practices: Provide product context, measured margins, acquisition costs, refund history, and the intended observation window.
Verify current platform policies and obtain authorization before sending, publishing, changing program settings, or making payouts.
Use neutral review eligibility, protect customer details, and preserve source evidence and testimonial permissions.
anti_patterns: Treating lifetime revenue as the reward budget or counting the same refund or discount twice.
Reporting attributed sales as proven incremental growth or assuming a paid status confirms a money transfer.
Buying positive reviews, excluding dissatisfied customers, fabricating testimonials, or publishing private customer records.

faq.question: What is the difference between referrals and affiliates?
faq.answer: Referral programs reward existing customers for recommendations. Affiliate programs pay partners who promote the product, often through an ongoing commission relationship.

faq.question: Does the skill send invitations or pay affiliates?
faq.answer: It provides plans and drafts. Actual sends and payments need configured tools, verified capabilities, and authorization for those actions.

faq.question: Can it calculate a referral reward budget?
faq.answer: Yes. It subtracts other acquisition costs from target CAC and counts both sides of a reward within the remaining budget.

faq.question: Can it help with customer reviews?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports neutral invitations, response drafts, reputation triage, and testimonial permission records without impersonating customers or suppressing criticism.

faq.question: Are review incentives allowed?
faq.answer: Rules vary by platform. Verify current official policies and campaign terms; disclosure alone does not make a prohibited incentive acceptable.

faq.question: Which AI tools are supported?
faq.answer: The skill is intended for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. External platform access depends on separately configured integrations and permissions.
